## Checklist

- [ ] `bash scripts/lint.sh` passes, or I could not run it here and I say so above (CI will check).
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes, and docs for anything users will notice.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, invite codes, personal data, or any other session, join or login credential, including values printed by `spawn client join`, and no content copied from someone's Spawn world.
- [ ] I did not copy text, code or art that I cannot license under Apache-2.0 (Spawn's own docs, skills and client are not ours to copy).
- [ ] I certify the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/) for my commits (`git commit -s` adds the `Signed-off-by` line; in GitHub's web editor, type it as the last line of the commit description box). Only a person can sign off; an AI agent never does. (For a pull request from a project agent account, the maintainer who merges it signs off.)
- [ ] If this touches token handling, the sender allowlist, routing, CI or agent instructions, I say so above, so a second reviewer can be found.

## AI assistance

We welcome AI-assisted contributions, and a person is always accountable for them. See [AI-assisted contributions](https://github.com/kdtix-open/sdlca-for-spawn/blob/main/docs/contributing/ai-assisted-contributions.md) for what to say. If an AI tool wrote or shaped much of this, please open the pull request as a draft until you have reviewed it yourself.

Tick one:

- [ ] An AI tool did more than spelling, formatting, autocomplete or a mechanical rename. Tool and model (also add an `Assisted-by:` trailer to the commit): <!-- e.g. Claude Code, claude-sonnet-5-5 -->
- [ ] No. I used no AI tool, or only for spelling, formatting, autocomplete or a mechanical rename.

If you ticked the first box:

- [ ] I have read every changed line, I can explain it in my own words, and I will answer review comments myself.
